profile.title: M.Sc. Computer Science Student
profile.headline: I come with a background in Conga & Salesforce Consulting (and Development) along with operational experience in the sales lifecycle. Naturally, I am well-versed in the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle using the Conga Product Suite (CPQ, CLM) and am learning modern Revenue Management and Operations tooling in the AI era. I am also learning platform-agnostic development with security in mind.

projects.name: Salesforce native application for querying Salesforce Attachments and Files
projects.description: A Lightning Web Component (LWC) built on the Salesforce platform that allows users to query and manage Attachments and Files directly from their Salesforce org, streamlining document handling and optimizing org storage. It is no longer relevant as Attachments have been deprecated, so it serves as an example of a Salesforce-native application built using LWC and Apex.

projects.name: Data Analytics: Binary Classification prediction model
projects.description: A binary classification model using Python and scikit-learn to predict likely insurance claims based on historical data. It compares multiple algorithms to determine the most effective approach using False Negative Rate (FNR) as the evaluation metric, demonstrating practical machine learning and data analysis skills.

projects.name: Full Stack Task Manager
projects.description: A basic task manager application built with FastAPI, Next.js, and PostgreSQL, featuring RESTful APIs for task management, a simple frontend interface for task organization and tracking, and a database to store tasks. It was further modified to include user authentication and authorization, ensuring that only authorized users can access and modify their tasks using a microservices architecture.

experiences.summary: I was tasked with supporting the platform migration of a CPQ solution from Salesforce Conga to the Conga Advantage Platform for an energy equipment manufacturer. I received training on the Conga Advantage Platform and its features, and contributed to optimizing an integration module (reducing its runtime) between an external configurator that configures products and creates cart line items, which are then fed to the Salesforce Cart for pricing and subsequent downstream actions.

experiences.company: Tesla Eco Tech, P.V.E, Redline Games (Small Enterprises)
experiences.summary: I was involved in the consulting, implementation, and adoption of digital solutions in business operations (mostly in the sales lifecycle) as well as IT support and administration. This included setting up a CRM (HubSpot Free Edition) for lead/opportunity tracking and automations (Zapier Free Edition) for alerts in the sales lifecycle. There were many side projects, including, but not limited to, GTM strategies (Life Cycle Assessment of raw materials for recycling to expand into new markets) and CLV (Customer Lifetime Value) analysis (adopting analytics tools like Google/Firebase Analytics for mobile games to estimate engagement and retention, and plan marketing strategies). I also kept in touch with the Salesforce ecosystem by learning SFDX and JavaScript for LWCs.

experiences.company: Conga (B2B SaaS, formerly known as Apttus)
experiences.summary: I was tasked with providing technical consultation and supporting Conga product (CPQ, CLM, and Billing) implementations, typically for high-value clients (ACV > $10M, Sector: Medical Equipment Manufacturer, Fintech, SaaS, Consumer Electronics, Energy: integrated Oil & Gas, Auto Insurance & Roadside Assistance, and more). Conga (then Apttus) product offerings were hosted on several platforms (Salesforce, Apttus Intelligence Cloud on Azure, and MS Dynamics). I was trained as an Apttus CPQ, CLM, and Billing Admin to help with the responsibilities of the role along with Salesforce platform administration, since the majority of the client base was using the Salesforce offering (a managed package on the AppExchange) while the other two platforms were slated for end-of-life shortly. This also included providing technical guidance on best practices for using the Conga Product Suite and ensuring that clients were able to fully leverage the capabilities of the suite.
